_comment: Who may use Eyes & Hands. In the harness this is the one access policy file the harness port reads too (HS_ACCESS_FILE, default <PROFILE_DIR>/hammerspoon/access.json), so merge these owners into it, or add them with `eyeshands access allow`. Default deny: an owner that is not listed and enabled cannot arm. Capabilities: eyes (AX reads), shot (screen pixels; only with eyes), hands (posted input). apps: the target names (targets file) and bundle ids the owner may read or drive. Keys starting with _ are comments.
